_note: MapForMe app runtime config for the OSM Nominatim fallback. Served to the app over https; contains no user data and the app sends no identifiers when fetching it. See src/services/geo/osmGeocoderConfig.ts in the app repo.
_why: The OSMF Nominatim usage policy requires apps distributed to end users to be able to switch the service on request WITHOUT a software update. This file is that switch.

_fields.enabled: false stops the OSM fallback entirely (kill switch). Spots are simply left without coordinates.
_fields.endpoint: Nominatim-compatible search endpoint. Must be https. Point this at a self-hosted instance to move off the public one.
_fields.minIntervalMs: Minimum interval between requests. The app clamps this to at least 1000ms - it can only ever be made slower, never faster.
